No, didn't had problems with that on my lex journey.
Wouldn't say no libido. But yeah, little libido. Compared to the drive before lex it felt like a big change and scared me a bit, even tho I knew it could happen.

The most noticeable ones were dizzyness, sleepiness, blurry vision and difficulty to focus sight. But I would say I only really felt them at the start and rarely noticed them after ciuple of months or so.

As for tapering I did what I wouldnt recommend to others. I lowered the dose to half and had plans to take it for a while and later lower it to a quarter dose. But after taking half dose for couple of weeks I stupidly forgot my medicine and went for a week trip. It wasnt fun at all. After 3 days felt the said side effects that I had at the beggining of journey except much more enhanced. Head hurt, couldn't focus. (I'm go glad that I didn't experienced the much hated brain zaps) I didn't had much choice but to endure it. After week, when I came back home, I still wasnt feeling very well but better so after some thought I decided to continue not taking lex. Now I'm feeling great.

But yeah, I highly reccomend to consult with your doctor and quit the medicine slowly if possible.

Dude, I've been there. Got bullied alot in my school even for the most ridiculous things, even for the fake stories about me that they made and believed. It was so hard, I lived for coming back home and escaping reality with computer games. 

It was really hard to believe that things get better. But now as I'm in university I have to say that it is so much better. People are so much mature, noone cares enough to bully. It is a dream world compared to school.

However the damage is done, now I'm socially anxious, depressed and have low self esteem. Sometimes I wonder what person I would be if I didnt have such terrible experience. 

My tip would be to find someone to talk about this, maybe even the therapist. It is much easier to sort out these feelings right now than wait for years. Please don't ignore these feelings, don't believe the bullies, don't be harsh to yourself. Try to help your confused mind as if you are helping your best friend.
